notes.title: Steam community items are now available!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

'Tis the season for giving! We're thrilled to announce that exclusive [b]Steam Community Items[/b] are now available to players:
[list]
[*] New profile badges, with a sweet golden foil for collectors
[*] Nine new trading cards featuring character portraits
[*] Seven profile backgrounds with dark and eye-watering art from the game
[*] Ten unique emoticons to use around Steam.
[/list]
Players will be retroactively rewarded with trading cards for their previous playtime. The new backgrounds and emoticons are also available from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/1110910]Points Shop[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37287879/64a4769a28376c932b3a84128eeb9dff2767f783.png[/img]

[h3]Winter Sale[/h3]
In addition, if Mortal Shell and/or The Virtuous Cycle are still on your wishlist, you can pick them up now at 40% and 25% discounts during the Winter Sale! Ends on 5th January.

Merry Christmas!

[i]-Team Mortal Shell[/i]

notes.title: Patch 1.014707
notes.content:
Thanks to you, our dedicated community, we've been able to identify and implement fixes for frequently reported issues since the release of The Virtuous Cycle. Please find the latest list of changes below.

[h2]Update Notes for Build 08.25.21 Revision 1.014707[/h2]
[list]
[*] Twin-Sister's dialogues when acquiring a new Instinct can now be skipped with the mouse
[*] Fixed an audio-related bug that was causing crashes on PC
[*] The user can now progress from the Seed Window at the end of a cycle with the mouse by clicking the "Continue" button
[*] Axatana Weapon Abilities should no longer get interrupted by the shield bash from Gragu or kick attacks from vampires
[*] Solomon's Accretion of Inheritance ability should now work correctly when equipped by Hadern
[*] Fixed the "hidden mouse cursor" bug that affected the "New Instinct Acquired" window
[*] The user can no longer gain resolve from Axatana Weapon Abilities
[/list]
[h2]Update Notes for Previous Build 08.20.21 Revision 1.014622[/h2]
[list]
[*] Issue with the Axe Super glitching when landing on top of an enemy has been fixed
[*] Issue with the Dual Katanas Super getting interrupted has been fixed
[*] Issue with the Dark Shell Boss Fight hard-locking after dealing the final blow has been fixed
[*] Issue that blocks trading with Hadern when reaching NG+ has been fixed
[*] Resolve Cost for the Axatana Weapon Ability is now correctly reduced when Hadern's ability is active
[*] Change to make how to access The Virtuous Cycle clearer
[*] Additions to the End Credits
[*] Other small bug fixes and improvements
[/list]
[h2]Bug Reporting[/h2]
Bugs can be reported [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1110910/discussions/1/]here on our Steam Discussions[/url].

When reporting a bug, please have the following information to hand:
[list]
[*] What was the issue?
[*] What game version is displayed in the bottom left of the main menu?
[*] What did you do to have it happen?
[*] Does it happen if you try to reproduce it using the same steps you listed on the previous question?
[*] Which shell, weapon, and item were in use?
[*] Were either Rotting Christ or The Virtuous Cycle content enabled?
[*] What are your system specs?
[/list]
If you have video or images you wish to share illustrating your bug, please consider using our [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdNYZOQEdGeDw9pEgjYtilCVz3ZymaJDFB8A0QPPsCKH3j0IA/viewform]bug reports form[/url].

We are continuing to use information shared through bug reports to work on further improvements to the stability and performance of the game.

notes.title: Mortal Shell's Release Date! (+ Details on The Virtuous Cycle!)
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We get asked all kinds of questions from our fans, but the most common one by far is "Steam When". Today we are delighted to say we finally have the answer for you: 

[h2]Mortal Shell and The Virtuous Cycle: Coming to Steam August 18[/h2]

And to mark the occasion, we have just revealed a world-first gameplay trailer of The Virtuous Cycle, our roguelike expansion. Take a look:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q8HZ70J8eXU

[h3]Here’s a rundown of The Virtuous Cycle’s new features:[/h3]

[h3]New Mode[/h3]
Carve through an ever-changing world where no two playthroughs are the same. Craft your own combat style by combining more than 100 unique upgrades.

[h3]New Shell[/h3]
Possess a familiar and formidable foe, Hadern. Unearth his true potential and demand perfection from this once-elusive Shell.

[h3]New Weapon[/h3]
Fallgrim’s most venerable weapon has been cast. Transform your combat with the Axatana, a manipulable hilt of two blades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37287879/fe23c269baa27143b47d1249f3111e14a30f0770.gif[/img]

And of course, new lore that sheds light on Fallgrim’s mysterious past.

Catch us on [url=https://twitter.com/MortalShellGame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/MortalShellGame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/mortalshellgame/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://discord.gg/mortalshell]Discord[/url] for all the latest news and content.

We can’t wait for your journey to begin.

-Team Mortal Shell
